currently.title: Currently
currently.paragraph1: As a Product Engineer at Prizmstack, I'm building FIJI: a valuation platform for real estate businesses. I work on the migration from no-code to Next.js and build the value simulation engine.
currently.stack: Current stack: TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase.
currently.paragraph2: In parallel, I teach Digital Techniques at IPSAJ (Instituto Politécnico San Arnoldo Janssen) to Electronics students. Combining production code with teaching pushes me to think about how people learn to build software.
currently.paragraph3: Open to new opportunities in LATAM (remote preferred), ideally in healthtech, fintech, or startups with interesting products. For broader conversations too: email me or book a call.

research.description: Papers, long-form essays and technical analyses. Written in paper-mode: serif, numbered sections, citations.

intro.paragraph1: Product Engineer with 4 years building product in Next.js + TypeScript. Based in Argentina, working remotely with teams in the US and LATAM. My role sits between code, product decisions and business metrics. I don't just ship features; I decide which ones are worth shipping.
intro.paragraph2: My background is atypical: I'm a bioengineer from ITBA, with a thesis on cancer mortality prediction using data from Hospital Italiano de Buenos Aires. That training left me with a quantitative instinct I now apply to modeling features, measuring impact, and prioritizing. I went from frontend to Product Engineer in 4 years: Techstars W24 with a founding team in New York, tech lead on B2B/B2C projects with 1,500+ active users, and now product decisions on roadmap and priorities.
intro.paragraph3: I'm open to new opportunities, especially with teams where product, engineering, and business get discussed at the same table: healthtech, fintech, or growing startups. But if it's something else, like a product you're thinking about, a possible collaboration, or just getting to know each other, book a call and we'll talk. If it's about a specific role, you can also email me or grab my CV.

tools.intro: I primarily work with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL on product projects. Experienced with payment integrations (Stripe, Mercado Pago, PayPal) and migrating stacks from no-code to code (Bubble → Next.js).
